Use case: productivity-visual / scientific-educational. Create ONE finished Chinese university presentation slide, 4:3 landscape, 1448x1086 or higher same ratio. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MASTHEAD reference: preserve its entire light-blue masthead at the top 13.5%, course name “大数据与生成式AI” at left, original Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications emblem and Chinese/English university wordmark at right. Preserve brand artwork and proportions; do not invent another logo. Replace all content below the masthead.

Match the polished blue-white academic keynote aesthetic: white canvas, deep navy #07365D titles, azure #267FB6 emphasis, slate-blue body, pale ice-blue rules and fills, crisp anti-aliased Chinese sans-serif. Strong editorial hierarchy, meaningful explanatory graphics, meticulous alignment. Visually rich but readable, no crowding and no pointless blank gaps. One coherent flat composition; no dashboard/card grid, UI buttons, pill labels, heavy shadows, dark body backgrounds or gratuitous 3D. Use restrained precise blue line-art icons. No sources, citations, URLs, report credits or source footers on canvas. No invented business results, performance numbers or real deployment claims. Only the finished slide image, no mockup frame. Render all required Chinese accurately. 
SLIDE 09
Title: 批处理与实时处理
Subtitle: 批处理按批次集中计算，实时处理持续响应新到达的数据

Main visual: an elegant TWO-LANE TIME COMPARISON for the SAME ecommerce order stream. Clearly show why outputs arrive differently. Top lane labelled 批处理 with order-event symbols accumulating, then a grouped batch, a clock, and a daily-report icon; below lane labelled 实时处理 with event symbols arriving progressively, incremental computation, and a monitoring display. Fine directional connectors, clear spacing. No numerical latency claims or zero-delay implication.
Exact main lane labels:
批处理：订单积累 → 定时汇总 → 输出日报
Output caption: 日支付金额、订单量、商品销售排行
实时处理：新交易到达 → 持续计算 → 更新监测结果
Output caption: 最新交易状态、异常提示
Use visual blocks only where they represent a batch of actual events, not generic UI containers.

Below timelines, three carefully aligned small icon/text items:
迟到事件
数据可能晚于交易发生时间到达
重复事件
识别重复上报，避免重复计算
故障恢复
恢复处理进度，并核对结果

A modest small note: 实时处理也可以采用微批方式
Bottom takeaway in navy: 实时强调及时响应，仍存在采集、传输和计算延迟。
Page number lower right: 9.
Keep conceptual time order clear. A batch is triggered at a scheduled time; real-time output has finite processing time. Do not imply that batch processing only runs daily. Use blue line art and refined pale-blue bands for the two timeline lanes, balanced and professional.

SLIDE 10
Title: 数据仓库、数据湖与湖仓一体
Subtitle: 围绕数据如何组织、管理和使用，理解三类架构

Main composition: a polished THREE-COLUMN COMPARISON TABLE, topped with three distinct restrained blue diagram icons: warehouse analysis tables, mixed-format files in a storage layer, and a lake storage layer with managed tables/transaction/version symbols above it. These are technical illustrations, NOT literal photos of a lake or warehouse. Equal visual weight, no rankings, no best-choice badge, no staircase implying inevitable replacement. Use slim rules and generous readable cells, not three rounded UI cards.

Exact column headings:
比较维度 | 数据仓库 | 数据湖 | 湖仓一体

Three comparison rows:
主要用途 | 报表、统一指标与分析 | 多形态资料保存、探索与加工 | 湖上数据表管理、分析与加工
典型组织 | 建模后的分析表 | 订单文件、日志、文档、图片 | 受管理表与原始资料共存
管理重点 | 主题建模、指标定义 | 目录、权限、质量与生命周期 | 表格式、事务、版本及配套治理

Under the table, an understated open editorial business-example row with a small ecommerce icon:
业务例子
日志和图片保存在湖中，订单分析表由数仓或湖仓管理，经营看板读取统一指标。

A small clarification: 事务和版本能力主要针对受管理的数据表
Bottom takeaway: 三者可以共存，选择取决于业务需求、数据特点与治理能力。
Page number lower right: 10.
Do not claim warehouses can only store structured data. Do not claim lakes have no governance. Do not claim every raw image/file automatically gains table transactions. Flat coherent presentation layout with navy headings and pale-blue alternating table rows.

SLIDE 11
Title: 为什么需要分布式计算
Subtitle: 将大任务拆成多个小任务，多台机器协作计算，再汇总结果

Input image 2 is a REAL photograph from Google's official New Albany data-center gallery. Use that supplied photograph as a small supporting inset, not a newly invented photorealistic data center. Preserve its visible rack/cable/aisle content and perspective as faithfully as possible; cropping into a modest landscape frame is allowed. Caption it only “机房实景参考”. It is not a photograph of the 2004 experiment. Main diagram must remain dominant.

Main visual: a clear principle diagram of log word-count computation. Input logs split across THREE worker machines, each produces a LOCAL count; matching words are grouped together and the counts are added into ONE final result. The locally counted sample should be fully readable and arithmetically exact.

Three sample shards and their local results:
分片A
pay pay view
本地统计：pay 2，view 1

分片B
pay refund view
本地统计：pay 1，refund 1，view 1

分片C
view refund
本地统计：view 1，refund 1

Between workers and final result, label: 按词归组并汇总
Final results prominently:
pay：3
view：3
refund：2

Use small server icons and precise connectors that show all three shards contributing. A subtle dashed retry loop on one worker can illustrate recovery, labelled “失败后重试”; don't drop a shard from the final answer.

Below, two concise explanation items:
失败重试：失败任务可重新分配，汇总时避免重复计数。
协作开销：数据传输、任务调度和结果汇总也需要时间。

Modest historical annotation: MapReduce原论文发表于2004年
Small sample label: 教学构造，原理示意
Bottom takeaway: 多机协作扩大处理能力，加速效果取决于任务拆分与协作开销。
Page number lower right: 11.
No fabricated speedup ratio, server quantity of a real company, or measured throughput. The shard example is deliberately small to explain a large-scale principle. Balance diagram, concise text, and a small real-photo inset; no crowding.

SLIDE 12
Title: 数据质量与治理
Subtitle: 让数据可信、口径一致，并在授权范围内使用

Main composition: two aligned compact ORDER TABLES labelled 清洗前 and 处理后, connected by a restrained directional arrow. Use professional navy/blue table headers, pale-blue row fills and subtle highlighting (duplicate/empty/wrong status), with clear type. Keep it flat and editorial, no software dashboard UI. This is a constructed classroom example.

Exact LEFT table:
订单编号 | 金额 | 支付状态
A1001 | 128元 | 已支付
A1001 | 128元 | 已支付
A1002 | 缺失 | 已支付
A1003 | 89元 | 已支付*

Exact RIGHT table:
订单编号 | 金额（元） | 支付状态
A1001 | 128.00 | 已支付
A1002 | 空值 | 已支付
A1003 | 89.00 | 未支付

Show these short operation labels on/beneath the transition, legibly:
去除重复
统一格式
核验标签

Under tables, a precise short note:
教学构造：A1003依据原始支付记录更正；缺失金额保留为空，不以0代替。

Lower body contains TWO explanatory governance rows with tasteful small icons:
统一口径
支付金额按支付时间归日，退款另行统计。
控制访问
按角色开放必要数据，敏感字段按要求脱敏。

A modest metadata line:
数据负责人：订单数据组　版本：v1.1　允许用途：教学演示

Bottom takeaway:
分析与AI使用数据之前，先确认质量、口径、版本和授权。
Page number lower right: 12.
Important: do not infer payment status from missing amount; A1003 status correction is specifically confirmed against original payment records. Do not fill missing amount with a fabricated number or zero. Keep all five issues represented: missing, duplicate, label error, inconsistent metric definitions, access permissions. No fabricated real organization metrics. Maintain calm clean whitespace while fitting all key content.
